title: Best Curtains (2026)
summary: The guide highlights the Best Home Fashion Thermal Blackout Curtains as the top pick for most buyers, with Deconovo, Pottery Barn, West Elm, Target, and Amazon offering solid alternatives.
method: Products were selected from consumerreports.org, bobvila.com, wired.com, and thegoodtrade.com. Picks were ranked by the number of sources that mentioned them and by the features highlighted in those sources.
assumptions: Prices are not provided because none of the sources listed them.
